nest-add.description: Add RabbitMQ support to a NestJS project

add-exchange.description: Add a broker exchange to config.yaml (optionally with a bound queue)

add-queue.description: Add a broker queue to config.yaml (creates the exchange if missing; growth bounds)

add-topic.description: Add a broker topic to config.yaml (creates queue/exchange if missing)

add-reply-queue.description: Map an exchange to an RPC reply queue via broker.replyQueues

enable-retry.description: Configure a bounded retry policy (broker.retry or topics[].retry) + declare the dead-letter exchange

enable-route-discovery.description: Enable publisher-side route auto-discovery (broker.routeDiscovery + fanout exchange)

set-connection-name.description: Set the logical AMQP connection_name (the lib auto-suffixes -hostname-pid per instance)

configure-broker.description: Set broker connection scalars (uri, prefetchCount, defaultRpcTimeout, init/manager options, credentials)

add-auth-provider.description: Add an auth-providers[] entry (jwt | jwks | basic | str-compare | none)

add-gateway.description: Promote a config to a gateway: remove publisher route-discovery, add rlb-acl/admin/control infra + gateway section

add-route.description: Add an HTTP route (gateway.paths[]) forwarding to a topic/action

add-metrics-topic.description: Isolate gw-metrics-track on a dedicated bounded topic/queue and point gateway.metrics at it

enable-load-config.description: Add gateway.loadConfig (pull DB-managed routes/events, merged with YAML, on (re)load)

harden-gateway.description: Add gateway hardening limits (maxConcurrentRequests, maxBodyBytes + main.ts body parser, upload, ws.maxBufferedBytes)
